chapter_title_en: The Karma of Tea and a Shadowy Alliance
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0421: Karma, Alliances, and the Cloud of Blood Tower
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning meets the reclusive Celestial Immortal Tonghe. A chilling warning about the Three Realms' calamity, a new alliance, and the shocking reveal of the Basilisk Combined Formation's master—the Cloud of Blood Tower.
og_title: The Calamity Looms: Ji Ning Unearths a Deadly Connection
og_description: A peaceful tea session hides geopolitical bombshells. Tonghe's philosophy of severing Karma sets the stage for a desperate alliance as Ji Ning discovers the secret behind the Basilisk Combined Formation.
twitter_title: Tea, Karma, and Assassins: The Calm Before the Storm in Desolate Era
twitter_description: Ji Ning learns the only force in the Grand Xia that knows the Basilisk Formation is the Cloud of Blood Tower, setting up a major conflict.

lore_anchors.definition: The universal law of cause and effect. In Xianxia, every action, friendship, and bond creates Karmic ties (因果). Severing these ties is a strategy to avoid attracting danger and living a long, isolated life.
The pinnacle of Ki Refining after surviving the Heavenly Tribulation. A being who has transcended the Five Elements and the mortal world, possessing a theoretically infinite lifespan.
The primary setting of the early narrative; a vast major world within the Three Realms, ruled by the Xia Emperor.
A rare and powerful formation technique. The name suggests it imitates the fabled giant serpent, the Bashe (巴蛇), a creature from Chinese mythology capable of swallowing elephants.
The foremost assassin organization in the Grand Xia World. An ancient and shadowy force, revealed to be a key pawn of the mysterious hidden hand opposing the Grand Xia Dynasty.
The founder of Heavenly Treasures Mountain; a powerful figure whose personal appearance signals a matter of extreme importance and the high status of the person making the inquiry.
A strategic philosophy where a powerful cultivator pretends to die to sever their Karmic ties and avoid being drawn into the conflicts and tribulations of the world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Celestial Immortal Tonghe living like a mortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is practicing a strategy called 'Feigned Death' to sever his Karmic ties. By convincing the world he is dead, he avoids being drawn into the conflicts of his friends and enemies, allowing him to live for eons in peace.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the great calamity Tonghe warns about?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a large-scale conflict sweeping the Three Realms, an inevitable storm that even top-tier Celestial Immortals, True Immortals, and Empyrean Gods may not survive. It is the overarching conflict that sets the stage for the later novels.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is behind the Cloud of Blood Tower?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Cloud of Blood Tower is just one piece of a much larger network of secret forces, all serving the same 'hidden hand' that is the Grand Xia Dynasty's greatest enemy. Its full nature is yet to be revealed.
